findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: stamp_check_email_domain · Private data: stamp_check_email_domain, stamp_check_dns_record · Public sink: stamp_check_email_domain, stamp_check_dns_record.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: stamp_check_email_domain · Private data: stamp_check_email_domain, stamp_check_dns_record · Public sink: stamp_check_email_domain, stamp_check_dns_record

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
